title: LINES NOBODY CAN SEE GO
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD and never says what nobody can read. Going down said a long sentence in the feed under the downed screen, which already shows DOWN, the bleed bar and his words SELF-REVIVE, one per raid. Being hauled aboard and abandoning said a line in the same frame the outcome card covers the raid, and the card already shows the XP fee. An emote narrated itself (You raise a hand) while the bubble over you showed it. Those lines are gone.
now: Going down, being hauled out, abandoning and emotes no longer say lines that the downed screen, the outcome card or the bubble already show.
